Monte Lupo produces beautiful handmade ceramic and textile artworks and homewares, and provides employment opportunities for people living with disability. *************************************************************************** Beachy Keen is a whimsical, sun-drenched celebration of summer, surf, and seaside charm. This exuberant sculpture exhibition brings together a kaleidoscope of beach-inspired artworks that revel in the joy, nostalgia, and cheeky spirit of coastal life. From dazzling mermaids lounging on coral thrones to bikini-clad beach babes striking playful poses, each sculpture bursts with personality, colour, and movement. The exhibition captures the essence of summer fun—ice creams melting in the sun, salty breezes, and the carefree laughter of beachgoers. With a palette as bright as a beach umbrella and forms as fluid as the ocean waves, Beachy Keen invites visitors to dive into a world where fantasy meets shoreline. Expect oversized sunnies, retro swimwear, and a splash of kitsch—all lovingly sculpted to evoke smiles and sun-soaked memories. Whether you're a surfer at heart or a sandcastle architect, this exhibition promises a joyful escape into a world of shimmering seashells, playful poses, and the eternal allure of the beach.
